How to make Green Apple Ice Cream Apple 🍏: Peel, core, and cut 5 Granny Smith apples into small chunks. Add the apples, 30 g water, 80 g sugar, and 10 g lemon juice to a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until the apples are completely soft, then blend until smooth. Transfer the apple puree to a shallow container. Stir in the juice of 1 lemon and ¼ cup of sugar, then freeze overnight until completely solid. (The first addition of 10g lemon juice prevents the apples from browning, while the second addition of one lemon juice is for adding a tangy flavor.) The next day, whip 200 g heavy cream, 60 g sweetened condensed milk, and 1 tsp vanilla extract until stiff peaks form. Use a fork to scrape the frozen apple puree into fine flakes. Add the flakes to the whipped cream and gently mix until evenly combined. Transfer the mixture to an airtight container and freeze overnight before serving. ❤ #tiktokrecipecontest #icecream #dessert #fruit #homecooking

🍓🍫 Homemade Magnum Ice Cream Bars – Super Creamy & Easy! 🛒 Ingredients • 200 g dark chocolate • 4 cups heavy whipping cream • 4 packets whipped cream stabilizer • 3 packets vanilla sugar • Fresh strawberries, finely diced • Sprinkles • Wooden popsicle sticks • Plastic cups (as molds) 🧑‍🍳 Instructions 1. Make the Chocolate Shell • Chop the dark chocolate and melt it gently. • Coat the inside (bottom and sides) of the plastic cups with the melted chocolate. • Freeze for 10–15 minutes, or until the chocolate has hardened. 2. Whip the Cream • Pour the heavy whipping cream into a large bowl. • Add the vanilla sugar and gradually add the whipped cream stabilizer. • Whip until the cream becomes thick, fluffy, and holds stiff peaks. 3. Add the Strawberries • Finely dice the strawberries. • Gently fold them into the whipped cream until evenly combined. 4. Fill the Cups • Spoon the strawberry cream mixture into the chocolate-lined cups. • Insert a wooden popsicle stick into the center of each one. 5. Add the Sprinkles • Sprinkle the top of each ice cream bar (the side where the popsicle stick is inserted) with colorful sprinkles. Once unmolded, this will become the bottom of the finished ice cream bar. 6. Freeze • Freeze for at least 4 hours, or overnight for the best texture. 7. Serve • Warm the outside of the plastic cups slightly with your hands or a little warm water. • Carefully pull out the ice cream bars and enjoy! Enjoy! 🍓🍫😋 #TikTokFood #icecream #fyp #viral #Recipe

Grooming Snip Its! Grooming an aggressive dog. I specialize in bad dogs and love educating about it.  I groom every bad dog a little differently. I have full confidence that I will be able to groom this dog without a muzzle within a few more sessions (maybe not for her nails though).  These types of dogs are not for everyone, and that is okay! A groomer who is not up for it, can make the dog worse. Part of doing a dog like this is having the time and patience to train them. Everytime I groom this dog, it will get better. It may take 3 sessions, it may take 12. But once we get there, the risk is worth it! The dogs aren't as stressed and neither is the groomer. Making it a positive experience everytime. The reason I dont let go until they are calm is because when they thrash and we let go, it teaches them cause and effect. If I do thrash, you let go. But because I'm letting go when they are calm, the cause and effect is now: when I relax, I get let go.  I typically dont use this many loops on a dog all at once. The "groomers helper" is a must for naughty dogs. It prevents the dog from being able to swing around and lower their head super low. Its connected to a locking loop. Those are my main 2. The green one is a safety precaution because this is a new dog. Its a self tightening loop that is super loose and not actually doing anything. Its only there incase the dog gets the muzzle and other loop off. The belly band is lose and is there so the dog doesnt step off the table. #doggrooming #snippet #helpfultips #baddog #aggressivedog
